'''Prism''' is a [[Common enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|The "Prismastagran" (archive ID: ASM316) is a non-model variant of ARM315. It is capable of protecting nearby Aggeloi, and is very difficult to hit as it often surrounds itself with ARM315 entities.}}

==Overview==
An abnormal variant of [[Hedron]], Prisms lost their ranged attacking abilities, but gain the ability to reduce the damage taken by up to two enemies by 90%. If no other enemy to protect is nearby, they will attack by pounding, dealing Physical damage in a small area. A Prism cannot buff another Prism.
